subject: Developing an interactive map of a shopping mall in R with Shiny

messages.author: e63f8700b8e76b1c
messages.subject: Developing an interactive map of a shopping mall in R with Shiny
parts: I am developing a dashboard for a shopping mall tracking the number of customers entering various stores and how many actually make a purchase. Is there a package compatible with Shiny which would help creating an interactive map of the mall? I think leaflet deals mostly with geographical areas.

messages.author: d6ebe55625e8e5a2
messages.subject: Re: Developing an interactive map of a shopping mall in R with Shiny
parts:
The underlying leaflet JS library has an article about using leaflet for non-geographical maps: http://leafletjs.com/examples/crs-simple/crs-simple.html
In that example, they wanted to (and did) create a star map for a computer game (Star Control II). That might be useful to you, though it may be a whole lot more custom than your regular geographical leaflet maps...
